dataset.source: original synthetic generator; not real payment data

methodology: Fixed hyperparameters; fit preprocessing/model on train, sigmoid calibration on calibration, minimum business cost on selection, one final test evaluation. Grid 0.01–0.99; costs rounded to cents (half upward, 1e-7 cent summation tolerance); ties choose higher threshold. No test-based model champion or threshold selection.
limitations: Synthetic stationary risk process; chronological order does not establish real-world temporal generalization.
No real-data benchmark, causal explanation, deployment monitoring or hiring/financial outcome guarantee.
Calibration is measured on test; no calibration or policy tuning uses test labels.
Test threshold curves are exploratory sensitivity analysis; deployable policy was fixed on selection.
Review capacity applies to the entire displayed evaluation window, not a daily arrival rate.
Single seeded split; no uncertainty intervals or cross-environment bitwise reproducibility claim.
